_comment: Actions with a documented supply-chain compromise. Matched on owner/repo regardless of which ref is used, because even a 'pinned' SHA could be one published during the compromise window.

actions.summary: Mutable version tags were force-moved to a malicious commit that dumped CI runner memory (including secrets) to workflow logs.
Compromised as part of the same campaign that hit tj-actions/changed-files; also had a tag force-moved to malicious code.
